metadata.question: Did Punjab and Haryana have the most amount of active fire detections in 2016 compared to all other years from 2012 to 2024?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS Fire data (MOD14A1 or MOD14A2 - thermal anomalies/active fires) - Time period: 2012-2024, focusing on 2016 vs all other years - Location: Punjab and Haryana states in India (need to define polygon geometries) - Aggregate fire detections by year and compare 2016 to other years 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed; we're using thermal anomaly detection - Filter by confidence level (confidence > 0) for reliable fire detections - Use appropriate MODIS fire band (e.g., "FireMask" or detection confidence) 3. Logic: - Count fire pixels/detections for each year 2012-2024 - Compare 2016 total to max of other years - Valid answer: A (Yes, 2016 was max) or B (No, another year had more) - Edge case: If no fire data found = C1, if pixel count = 0 = C2 ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Define Punjab and Haryana geometries (approximate bounding boxes) punjab = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([73.5, 29.5, 76.9, 32.5]) haryana = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([76.3, 27.0, 78.8, 30.9]) study_region = punjab.union(haryana) # 2. Load MODIS Active Fire data (MOD14A2 - 8-day composite) modis_fire = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A2') # 3. Calculate fire detections for each year (2012-2024) years = list(range(2012, 2025)) fire_counts = {} for year in years: start_date = f'{year}-01-01' end_date = f'{year}-12-31' col = modis_fire.filterDate(start_date, end_date).filterBounds(study_region) if col.size().getInfo() == 0: fire_counts[year] = 0 continue # Extract fire mask (values 1-14 indicate fire confidence levels) # Band: FireMask (0=no fire, 1-14=various confidence levels) fire_img = col.select('FireMask').map( lambda img: img.gte(1).multiply(img) # Keep only detected fires (>= confidence 1) ).sum() count = fire_img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=study_region, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get('FireMask').getInfo() if count is None: count = 0 fire_counts[year] = int(count) print(f"{year}: {fire_counts[year]} fire detections") # 4. Validate data availability total_detections = sum(fire_counts.values()) if total_detections == 0: print("No fire detections found for Punjab & Haryana (2012-2024).") print("C2") else: # 5. Compare 2016 to all other years count_2016 = fire_counts[2016] other_years = {y: c for y, c in fire_counts.items() if y != 2016} max_other = max(other_years.values()) if other_years else 0 max_other_year = max(other_years, key=other_years.get) if other_years else None print(f"\n2016 Detections: {count_2016}") print(f"Max Other Year ({max_other_year}): {max_other}") print(f"Total Period Detections: {total_detections}") if count_2016 > max_other: print("A") else: print("B") ```

import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Define Punjab and Haryana geometries (approximate bounding boxes)
punjab = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([73.5, 29.5, 76.9, 32.5])
haryana = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([76.3, 27.0, 78.8, 30.9])
study_region = punjab.union(haryana)

# 2. Load MODIS Active Fire data (MOD14A2 - 8-day composite)
modis_fire = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD14A2')

# 3. Calculate fire detections for each year (2012-2024)
years = list(range(2012, 2025))
fire_counts = {}

for year in years:
    start_date = f'{year}-01-01'
    end_date = f'{year}-12-31'
    
    col = modis_fire.filterDate(start_date, end_date).filterBounds(study_region)
    
    if col.size().getInfo() == 0:
        fire_counts[year] = 0
        continue
    
    # Extract fire mask (values 1-14 indicate fire confidence levels)
    # Band: FireMask (0=no fire, 1-14=various confidence levels)
    fire_img = col.select('FireMask').map(
        lambda img: img.gte(1).multiply(img)  # Keep only detected fires (>= confidence 1)
    ).sum()
    
    count = fire_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=study_region,
        scale=1000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('FireMask').getInfo()
    
    if count is None:
        count = 0
    fire_counts[year] = int(count)
    print(f"{year}: {fire_counts[year]} fire detections")

# 4. Validate data availability
total_detections = sum(fire_counts.values())
if total_detections == 0:
    print("No fire detections found for Punjab & Haryana (2012-2024).")
    print("C2")
else:
    # 5. Compare 2016 to all other years
    count_2016 = fire_counts[2016]
    other_years = {y: c for y, c in fire_counts.items() if y != 2016}
    max_other = max(other_years.values()) if other_years else 0
    max_other_year = max(other_years, key=other_years.get) if other_years else None
    
    print(f"\n2016 Detections: {count_2016}")
    print(f"Max Other Year ({max_other_year}): {max_other}")
    print(f"Total Period Detections: {total_detections}")
    
    if count_2016 > max_other:
        print("A")
    else:
        print("B")
